title: Composite Adaptive Higher-Order Control Barrier Functions for Joint Frequency-RoCoF Safety in Low-Inertia SIDS Microgrids
summary: Small Island Developing States (SIDS) face simultaneous frequency nadir and rate-of-change-of-frequency (RoCoF) violations under high renewable penetration. This paper proposes a \emph{Composite Adaptive Higher-Order Control Barrier Function} (CA-HOCBF) for BESS-coupled virtual synchronous generators that jointly enforces IEEE~1547 frequency ($\pm0.8$\,Hz) and ENTSO-E RoCoF ($\pm1$\,Hz/s) limits as hard safety constraints under parametric uncertainty.
